Name: Monster Eradication Tracker - Adventurer's Guild UI
Author: rafyaditya
Description:
[size=5][b]Monster Eradication Tracker - Adventurer's Guild UI[/b][/size]
[i]Everything about Monster Eradication Goals in one clean menu — kill progress, monster portraits, stats & drops, mine floor guides, Gil rewards, live pinned HUD, and optional remote claiming![/i]

Tired of walking all the way to the Adventurer's Guild just to check how many Dust Sprites or Serpents you have left — and still having to open the Wiki to look up where they spawn or what Gil gives you?

[b]Monster Eradication Tracker[/b] solves this with a complete, Stardew-styled encyclopedia and live tracker accessible anytime via a single hotkey.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Instant Hotkey Access:[/b] Press [b]G[/b] or [b]F7[/b] anytime to open the menu (hotkeys, HUD toggle keybind, and all settings are fully customizable via Generic Mod Config Menu).[/*]
[*][b]Clean 2-Column Monster Roster:[/b] Browse all eradication goals in a dedicated 6-row scrollable list with authentic monster sprites, visual progress bars, remaining kill counts, and clear status badges (In Progress, Ready to Claim, Completed). Smooth navigation via mouse wheel or centered scroll arrows.[/*]
[*][b]Authentic Monster Portraits & Reward Icons:[/b] Displays every monster sprite and Gil's actual reward item (with item tooltips, descriptions, and Marlon resell prices).[/*]
[*][b]Locations & Hunting Tips:[/b] Built-in floor ranges (The Mines, Skull Cavern, Volcano Dungeon, Mutant Bug Lair) and practical farming tips for every vanilla goal.[/*]
[*][b]Per-Variant Kill Breakdown, Stats & Drops:[/b] See exact kills per monster subtype (e.g., Green Slime vs. Frost Jelly vs. Sludge vs. Tiger Slime) alongside HP, Damage, Defense, EXP, and main drops.[/*]
[*][b]Live Pinned HUD Overlay:[/b] Pin goals you're currently hunting to track live kill progress directly on screen while fighting in the mines. Fully customizable in GMCM (5 screen positions, authentic wood or dark transparent frame, opacity, screen offsets, and auto-hide when completed/claimed).[/*]
[*][b]Optional Remote Gil Claiming & Morning Reminder:[/b] Claim completed Gil rewards straight from the menu (can be toggled off in GMCM for a pure tracker experience), plus a subtle morning notification when rewards are waiting.[/*]
[*][b]Direct Vanilla Board Access:[/b] One click to open Gil's original Adventurer's Guild parchment kill list anytime, from anywhere.[/*]
[*][b]Expansion Mod Compatible:[/b] Dynamically reads [i]DataLoader.MonsterSlayerQuests[/i] and [i]DataLoader.Monsters[/i], so custom Monster Slayer goals added by expansion mods appear automatically![/*]
[*][b]Localization Ready (i18n):[/b] Includes English ([i]default.json[/i]) and Indonesian ([i]id.json[/i]). Community translations welcome![/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (4.0.0+ for Stardew Valley 1.6).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the [b]AdventurerGuildTracker[/b] folder into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure keybinds, HUD corner/position, language, and notifications in-game.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Permissions & Translation Credits[/b][/size]
Community [i]i18n[/i] translations are warmly welcome! Please send translations or upload them as a translation pack referencing this mod.
